versions.subject: Merge PR #5762 from @HullaBrian - Unsigned .node File Load
versions.detection:
selection_node_extension:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '.node'
selection_status:
    - Signed: 'false'
    - SignatureStatus: 'Unavailable'
filter_optional_vscode_jupyter:
    Image|endswith: '\Code.exe'
    ImageLoaded|contains: '.vscode\extensions\ms-toolsai.jupyter-'
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
        - '\electron.napi.node'
        - '\node.napi.glibc.node'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*.node" Signed="false" OR SignatureStatus="Unavailable" NOT (Image="*\\Code.exe" ImageLoaded="*.vscode\\extensions\\ms-toolsai.jupyter-*" ImageLoaded IN ("*\\electron.napi.node", "*\\node.napi.glibc.node"))
